item.title: Dixwell Library Tech’s Long Bus Commute Could Speed Up
item.description: Stetson Library Technical Assistant Tyrone Dailey sat across the room from state transit officials presenting on a proposed Bus Rapid Transit route along Dixwell Avenue. As someone who often spends two hours a day commuting by bus, Dailey approved of the proposal to add a speedier option. item.title: Downtown Building Sold Amid Landlord’s “Overbuild” Concerns
item.description: A Fairfield-based investor has purchased a Temple Street retail-and-apartment building for $3.65 million -- after the property's previous owner decided not to hold onto it because of increased competition in New Haven's high-end housing market. item.title: NHPD Buys New Guns For Cops, Sells Old Guns To Retailer
item.description: Will New Haven police officers end up pointing their new guns at suspects holding their old guns? That could happen, now that the NHPD has purchased 450 new firearms and sold a similar number to a private retailer in Vermont. The post NHPD Buys New Guns For Cops, Sells Old Guns To Retailer appeared first on New Haven Independent.
